_comment: Page-level chrome and metadata for every route. The long-form prose on /download, /support, /help, /protection and the legal pages is not in here yet — it renders in English under every locale via the fallback in dictionaries.ts. Adding it is additive: put the strings here, translate, and wire the page up.

meta.title: Welockin — Block distractions before they block your future.
meta.description: Welockin blocks the apps that steal your attention — once and for all. One-click, impossible-to-bypass focus sessions across macOS, iOS, iPadOS and Windows.

meta.title: Download Welockin for Mac, iPhone, iPad and Windows
meta.description: Get Welockin on macOS, iPhone, iPad and Windows. Link as many devices as you want — they all lock together as one. Android coming soon.

download.lead: You can link as many devices as you want — they all lock at the same time. Install it on each one and a single session shuts everything down at once.
download.sub: A blocker that covers your laptop but not your phone is a blocker with a door in it, so cover everything before your first hard lock.

meta.title: Protection — Block adult & explicit sites for good
meta.description: Block adult content, gambling, dating apps and mature games across every device. Five unlock difficulty levels, on-device filtering, always on.

meta.title: Support — Fixes for the common issues
meta.description: Fixes for the issues people actually hit: a lock that won't lift, a forgotten password, a missing purchase — and how to reach a human when they don't.

support.lead: The issues people actually hit, with the fix for each — and a direct line to a human for everything else.

meta.title: Help — Getting started, your account, purchases and fixes
meta.description: Everything in one place: setting up Welockin, managing your account, subscriptions and the lifetime licence, and fixes when something isn't working.

help.lead: Everything in one place: setting Welockin up, managing your account, sorting out a purchase, and fixing things when they don't behave.

meta.title: Contact us
meta.description: Reach the Welockin team — support, billing, privacy or press. Send the form or email hello@welock.in; a real person reads every message.

contact.lead: A question, a bug, a billing hiccup or a press enquiry — send it over. Every message is read by the students who build Welockin, usually between lectures.

meta.title: Reset your password
meta.description: Set a new password for your Welockin account.

meta.title: Delete your account
meta.description: How to permanently delete your Welockin account and all associated data — from inside the app or by email. What gets deleted and how long it takes.

meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How Welockin handles your data: what we collect, why each permission is used, and how to delete your account. Your browsing stays on your device.

meta.title: Terms of Service
meta.description: The terms for using Welockin: the free trial, monthly and yearly subscriptions, the lifetime licence, refunds, and why the lock is built to hold.

meta.title: Payment received
meta.description: Jump back into Welockin — your licence is on your account.

thanks.title: You're all set
thanks.lead: Welockin unlocks by itself within a few seconds. If it didn't come to the front on its own, the button below brings it back.
thanks.fallback: Nothing happening? Open Welockin from your desktop or Start menu — it checks your licence every time it starts. You can close this tab.

meta.title: Blocked
meta.description: This site is blocked by Welockin.
